title: ID0376545-DC/Si-D/FI[ZgwY7b] - All outlets OoO
description:
Location:
Kalajoki MP / P7 170000678
Reported behaviour/issue:
No converter in multiple groups and other flags error flags.  All 10 converter seems to be found. Doing the converter grouping again and restarting the charger has no effect.
Root cause:
KF214's output has constant 12V in the fastshutdown causing the Converters to be permanently off
Solution: Replace KF214
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: Siemens
Warranty Status: Active
Action:  Fixed 4.9.2024. -KF214 replaced.

additional_info.subject: ID0376545-DC/Si-D/FI[ZgwY7b] - All outlets OoO CRM:00315001696
additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿Sakari,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P7 170000678
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
ZgwY7b
Problem Description
: All outlets out of order and some converters are cannot be turned on
Troubleshooting
:
This must be fate, this week I've had 2 similar tickets.
Here are the steps that I request of you to do during the site visit:
The converters from DC3 and DC4 are not being found but we can see the Serial Number
This means that something is preventing the converters from starting, the StateMonitor of the Dispenser is the responsible for this, as the Fast shutdown signal is constantly with 12 V and as such the converters are always in shutdown state.
Please measure in these arrows in red, if we have 12 V, you can measure it to the housing if the probes are short.
If you find the 12V in these points, then that means that the KF214 should be sending these 12V
As such, please measure in these points as well for the 12V in the dispenser
If we have 12V in these outputs from the KF214, that means that the internal switch/contactor is probably broken and cannot open and KF214 needs replacement.
Please take a spare KF214 with you in case we need to replace it.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0376545
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim

Hello Sakari, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
I want to request you to do one more thing.
After you measure all the point mentioned below, I would like to confirm that there is nothing wrong with also the converter and contactors.
What you need to do is, remove these 2 connections:
And let the converter grouping be performed again.
What I want to see is this difference:
This difference is due to the fact that the converter is not being powered on. Now we have a error flag = 52, that means that the converter is turned ON but fastshutdown check is failed. When we remove these 2 connections above this is what we should see.
Please let me know when you have the date scheduled so that I can provide you support remotely.
Thank you and have a nice day!
Best regards,
Francisco
